scope: Offline audit of the bounded UTF-8, DTD-free XML 1.0 Fifth Edition / Namespaces 1.0 admission profile against the official W3C XML Test Suite 20130923; original document bytes checked in both production recognizers without transport integration or deployment.
catalog_handling: The complete ZIP is pinned by SHA-256 before any catalog parsing; archive counts and uncompressed bytes are bounded. No archive members are extracted or executed.
The 21 catalog fragments referenced by the root catalog are read as data without external resolution; fragment-relative member paths and the applicable XML version/edition labels determine selection.
The root wrapper names a nonexistent eduni/namespaces/misc directory for the external eduni/misc fragment. The source fragment location is used for its relative test URIs.

DTD-invalid catalog cases are treated as well-formed for nonvalidating admission. DTD declarations, non-UTF-8 representations and cases requiring namespace processing disabled remain intentional profile denials.
DOCTYPE-like text inside comments, CDATA or processing instructions is not classified as a DTD declaration.
Catalog error cases allow either admission outcome; they check implementation parity without inventing a standards verdict.
The isolated Go driver copies the exact production recognizer with its package declaration changed and verifies the shared production byte ceiling.
limitations: This is not a complete XML processor conformance result. UTF-16, DTD processing, entity resolution and canonical output are intentionally outside the profile.
Passing the applicable collection does not establish universal protocol compliance or protection from every unknown attack.
Catalog executions are not globally unique payloads or attacks: 2001 selected entries contain 1983 distinct payloads.
These are recognizer checks; ordinary, range, multipart and MCP integration results remain in docs/xml-response-validation.json and were not rerun for this audit-only addition.
No production routing, sandbox enforcement or live deployment was exercised.
